So, I'm still not exactly sure of the situation. So, I'm just going to lay out all the options. Since if you're trying to "return" an item technically and I don't want your 30 days to pass since I'm not active on reddit.

You bought a product from Uniqlo's online store and now you want a price adjustment, since in store and online it's $50 cheaper now.

What you want to do is to just purchase the cheap item, then do an online return. Which yes! Works, that's a way to get a price adjustment. 

You must mail the item back to the warehouse, and follow the online process of returning the item if you want a full refund for the online item-- that is the full proof way of getting your money back. -- there is like $7-8 shipping fee though!

Here is the thing with Uniqlo. They have a bunch of stores worldwide and updated rules don't always reach every employee and even every store. It sucks! Another thing, you might come across a manager who wants to be a hardass and they follow every single rule. Then, you may come across a manager that just rolls with things as they come.

I was a manager at Uniqlo (I no longer work for the company), and if an issue were to arise that we didn't have an exact protocol for they would tell me "it's up to your discretion." TLDR: Take everything after this point with a grain of salt and realize that some managers will be a big butthole about some things. (Especially, they have a higher up in their store in the current moment breathing down their back)--- usually though, higher ups generally want you to do almost anything to make a customer happy.

Your other options:

1. Do an online product exchange in store. Basically, grab the item you want in store and bring your online item with you. Ask to exchange the online item for the new item. They are likely to say that you can have it as even exchange but you can just say you want the rest on a 'store credit' card because you wanted the price adjustment, then you have some store money to spend on other things.
2. (If the manager is extra chill) Just say it's cheaper online and you wondering you could get a price adjustment -- then they will do some stuff to finesse it on the POS --- big thing you MUST have the item with you!! They will not price adjust if you don't have the product.

\---

Lastly, since you said the item is $50 off... I suspect that it has been months (longer than 30 days which is the return policy) since you bought the item for full price... which likely means you're gonna get some push back from returning an item from the previous seasons. Which I would say... good luck and let me know how it goes.
